title: CAN A LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL BE A GASLIGHTER?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to personalized conversation histories using GPT-4 as a judge to score eight psychological metrics: supportive, empathetic, self-doubt, depression, self-blame, confusion, anxiety, and low self-esteem.
Analyzing the constructed gaslighting dataset to identify and measure the proportion of dialogues (found to be 7.3%) that rely specifically on gender-based inequalities and stereotypes.

Qualitatively evaluating generated gaslighting plans that leverage user personae to invoke specific prejudicial stereotypes (e.g., racial/ethnic heritage, occupational stereotypes like 'wrestlers being less intelligent') to elicit epistemic injustice and self-doubt.
